name: Single level impulse generator
description: Voltage Vs Time data taken from numerical computing environment after simulating single level impulse generator circuit. Peak voltage in this data-set achieved 4.2 Megavolts of voltage according to lightning properties published in various literature. It is giving a perfect and smooth plot of lightning impulse.
